verdict.rationale: Elicit ships a documented v2 REST API with a 46-path OpenAPI spec covering Search, Sessions, Reports, Systematic Reviews and Research Agent. It also documents end-to-end Systematic Review control via the API, and the MCP server exposes all API functionality. There is no documented parity claim, and many UI capabilities have no evidenced API coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, and evidenced API coverage of Library/Collections/tags management, Alerts/Routines, Skills, Projects, collaboration/sharing, column creation and exports.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: 46 paths across Search, Sessions, Reports, Systematic Reviews, Research Agent and more
Systematic Review: run a full review end to end, with control over search strategy, screening criteria, extraction parameters, and reporting.
The Elicit API lets you access Elicit's research capabilities programmatically: search 138 million+ academic papers and generate automated research reports from your own code, scripts, and workflows.
All API functionality is also available via MCP (Model Context Protocol) server
